title: SG-5.3.1 · Scene start plays the authored fade transition
summary: Scene start calls the fade transition with the duration authored in scene content
description: Context: bedroom.yaml authors a transition effect (fade, 400 ms) but buildEffects skips it and BootScene.create never calls EffectRenderContext.playTransition, so no fade plays. Desired behavior: scene start plays the fade using the content duration, and plays nothing when the scene has no transition entry. Why: the transition must be content-driven, as required by the layered scene renderer goal.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene with a fade transition entry, when the scene starts, then playTransition is called once with the entry durationMs
Given a scene with no transition entry, when the scene starts, then playTransition is never called

in_scope: Engine helper that plays the authored transition
Unit tests with a mocked context
preserve: Existing BootScene effect cleanup on SHUTDOWN

technical_constraints: Engine code stays free of Phaser imports and uses the injected EffectRenderContext
definition_of_done: Both requirements are met and their unit tests pass
